title: Extract SRD spell-embedded tables as table records
description: Follow-up from eshyra-4a7.3 document-wide table accounting. The Spellcasting chapter embeds 9 tables inside spell descriptions that are currently flattened into spell prose and tracked as known-gap coverage items: Animated Object Statistics (p116, animate objects), d10 Behavior (p127, confusion), Precipitation / Temperature / Wind (p131, control weather), Material Duration (p132, creation), d100 Race (p174, reincarnate), Knowledge/Save Modifier table (p176, scrying), and the Teleport 'Familiarity / Mishap / Similar Area / Off Target / On Target' matrix (p186). Emit each as a table record (or structured spell child data) with source row order and page provenance preserved, update the eshyra-4a7.3-followup known-gap coverage rule to record:/child-of: mappings, extend EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_TABLE_NAMES, and add exact-row regression tests. Several are multi-column with wrapped cells (Animated Object Statistics, Teleport) and may need bespoke reconstruction like the existing paired-column tables.
notes: Implemented nine spell-embedded table records with fail-closed source fingerprints, exact row/page regression coverage, explicit source-inventory mappings, and regenerated canonical pack. Follow-up: added optional spell.data.tableRefs links for the seven owning spells, shared importer/audit ownership invariants, dangling/missing/duplicate link checks, and source-preserving prose regression coverage. Table count remains 102; only seven generated spell records changed. Verified npm run verify:worktree (1657 passed, 19 skipped), npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack (exact), and rules-pack audit (0 suspicious).
close_reason: Spell-embedded tables are emitted and linked from their owning spells with fail-closed invariants.
